greeting: Hello {name}! I am AgriSmart. Ask me about weather, market prices, crops, plant diseases or government schemes.
help.app: You can ask me: what crop to grow, today's weather, the market price of your crop, government schemes, your expected yield and profit, or when to apply fertilizer. For a plant problem, I can look at a photo of the leaf.
help.phone: You can ask me: what crop to grow, today's weather, the market price of your crop, government schemes, your expected yield, or when to apply fertilizer. Press 0 at any time to change the language.
not_understood: Sorry, I did not understand. You can ask about weather, market prices, which crop to grow, plant diseases, schemes or fertilizer timing.
error.generic: Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again.
location_required: I need your location for this. Please add your village and district in your profile.
weather.rain_chance: Chance of rain today is {rain_prob}%, about {rain_mm} mm.
weather.tomorrow: Tomorrow: {condition}, {min} to {max}°C, {rain_prob}% chance of rain, about {rain_mm} mm.
alert.heavy_rain: Heavy rain of about {rain_mm} mm is expected. Clear field drains and postpone spraying and fertilizer.
alert.very_heavy_rain: Very heavy rain of about {rain_mm} mm is expected. Protect harvested produce, clear drains and keep animals safe.
alert.heat_stress: Very hot day expected, up to {temp_c}°C. Irrigate in the evening or early morning and protect young plants.
alert.cold_stress: Cold night expected, down to {temp_c}°C. Light irrigation in the evening helps protect crops from frost.
alert.avoid_spraying_rain: Rain is likely today. Avoid spraying pesticides or fertilizer; it may wash off.
alert.avoid_spraying_wind: Strong wind today, about {wind_kmh} km/h. Avoid spraying to prevent drift.
alert.dry_spell: No rain is expected for the next {days} days. Plan irrigation for your crops.
alert.delay_fertilizer: Rain is forecast when your fertilizer is due. Consider delaying the application by a day or two.
market.ask_crop: Which crop's price do you want? For example: tomato, onion or paddy.
market.no_data: I could not find a recent market price for {crop} near you.
market.price: {crop} at {market} mandi: ₹{modal} per quintal, ranging from ₹{min} to ₹{max}. This price was observed on {date}.
market.stale: The market service is not responding, so this is the last price we have.
crop.soil_required: To suggest a crop, I need your soil test values: nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium and pH. You can find them on your Soil Health Card.
crop.recommend: The most suitable crop for your field is {crop}. Other good options are {alternatives}.
disease.photo_request: Please take a clear photo of one affected leaf in daylight.
pest.photo_request: Please take a clear photo of the insect or the damaged part of the plant.
disease.phone_unsupported: Checking a plant disease needs a photo, which is not possible on this phone call. Please use the AgriSmart app on a smartphone, ask a family member to help, or visit your nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra. You can also call the Kisan Call Centre on 1800-180-1551.
disease.uncertain: I am not sure what this is. Please take another photo in daylight, close to one leaf, with the problem area clearly visible.
disease.healthy: The plant looks healthy. I am {confidence}% sure.
disease.result: This looks like {name}. I am {confidence}% sure. {action}
pest.result: This looks like {name}. I am {confidence}% sure. {action}
pest.beneficial: This is {name}, which is usually helpful or harmless to crops. I am {confidence}% sure.
disease.unverified_note: This advice is awaiting expert review; please confirm with your agriculture officer before spraying.
schemes.eligible: You may be eligible for {count} schemes, including {names}.
schemes.none: I could not find a matching scheme for you right now.
schemes.profile_needed: Add your age, land size and crops in your profile so I can check your eligibility exactly.
yield.ask_crop: For which crop do you want the yield estimate?
yield.unsupported: Yield estimates are not available for this crop yet.
yield.estimate: For {crop}, the expected yield is about {expected} quintal per acre, most likely between {low} and {high}. For {area} acres that is about {total} quintal.
profit.need_details: To calculate profit, I need your expected yield, selling price and costs. Please open the profit calculator.
profit.revenue_estimate: For {crop} on {area} acres, you may harvest about {quintals} quintal. At today's price of ₹{price} per quintal, that is about ₹{revenue} before costs. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed price.
calendar.none: You have no farm tasks planned for the next three weeks. Add your crop and sowing date to get a farming calendar.
unavailable.generic: This service is not available right now. Please try again later.
unavailable.model_unavailable: This prediction is not available yet. Please try again later.
unavailable.weather_unavailable: I cannot reach the weather service right now. Please try again later.
unavailable.market_unavailable: I cannot reach the market price service right now. Please try again later.
notify.calendar.title: Farm tasks tomorrow
notify.calendar.body: You have {count} farm task(s) planned for tomorrow. Open AgriSmart to see them.
notify.weather.title: Weather alert
voice.welcome: Hello. I am AgriSmart. How can I help you?
voice.didnt_hear: Sorry, I could not hear you. Please speak again.
voice.time_limit: We have reached the time limit for this call. Please call again. Thank you.
voice.unsupported_number: Sorry, this service is available only for Indian mobile numbers.
notify.scheme.title: New government scheme
notify.scheme.body: New scheme for farmers: {name}. Open AgriSmart to check if you are eligible.
notify.market.title: Market price alert
notify.market.up: {crop} prices in {state} are up {percent}% this week: about ₹{price} per quintal. A good time to plan your sale.
notify.market.down: {crop} prices in {state} are down {percent}% this week: about ₹{price} per quintal. If you can store safely, compare nearby mandis before selling.
notify.disease.title: Disease alert near you
notify.disease.body: {disease} has been found by {count} farmers in {district} this week. Check your crop today and open AgriSmart for prevention steps.
